origin.description: The default locale is UTF-8 and UTC. The decimal mark and the grouping mark must differ.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: The default locale is UTF-8 and UTC. The decimal mark and the grouping mark must differ.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
loc <- locale(decimal_mark = ",", grouping_mark = ".", tz = "UTC")
paste(loc$decimal_mark, loc$grouping_mark, loc$tz, loc$encoding, loc$date_names$mon[1], sep = ";")

translation.description: The default locale is UTF-8 and UTC. The decimal mark and the grouping mark must differ.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

translation.details: The default locale is UTF-8 and UTC. The decimal mark and the grouping mark must differ.
translation.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
translation.example:
loc = locale(decimal_mark=",", grouping_mark=".", tz="UTC")
return loc.decimal_mark + ";" + loc.grouping_mark + ";" + loc.tz + ";" + loc.encoding + ";" + loc.date_names.mon[0]
